Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my arguments have been cut off

Arabic text: فَلَا حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الْأَسِيرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي
Translation: I have no plea, for I am a prisoner of my affliction
Held in pledge by my deeds, wavering in my errors
Perplexed from my path, cut off from support

Arabic text: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِيْ مَوْقِفَ الْأَذِلَّاءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
Translation: I have placed myself in the position of the humiliated sinners

Arabic text: مَوْقِفَ الْأَشْقِيَاءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ
Translation: The position of the wretched who are audacious against You, who take Your promise lightly
Glory be to You! What audacity I have shown against You
And what delusion I have allowed myself
My Master, have mercy on my stumbling, for the sake of my dignity

Arabic text: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي
Translation: And my slipping feet, and return with Your forbearance upon my ignorance

Arabic text: وَبِإِحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إِسَاءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي
Translation: And with Your goodness upon my wrongdoing, for I acknowledge my sin
I confess my error, and here is my hand and my forelock
I submit to retaliation against myself
Have mercy on my gray hair, and the passing of my days
And the approach of my death, and my weakness
And my destitution, and my lack of means

Arabic text: مَوْلَايَ وَارْحَمْنِيْ إِذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي
Translation: My Master, have mercy on me when my trace is cut off from this world
And my remembrance is erased among the created beings

Arabic text: وَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَنْسِيِّينَ كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ
Translation: And I become among the forgotten ones, like one who is forgotten
My Master, have mercy on me at the changing of my appearance

Arabic text: وَحَالِيْ إِذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي
Translation: And my state when my body decays, and my limbs are scattered

Arabic text: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِي، يَا غَفْلَتِيْ عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِي
Translation: And my joints are severed. Oh, my heedlessness of what is intended for me!
My Master, have mercy on me in my gathering and resurrection

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَائِكَ مَوْقِفِي
Translation: And make my position on that day with Your friends
And my return among Your beloved ones

Arabic text: وَفِيْ جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And my dwelling in Your vicinity, O Lord of the worlds
